name: Hilton Los Angeles Airport
description:
Convenient Airport Shuttle Service
Benefit from the free 24-hour shuttle service to Los Angeles International Airport, ensuring a stress-free start or end to your trip.

Diverse Dining Options
Indulge in a variety of culinary experiences with 4 food venues to choose from, including American cuisine at The Café and northern Italian dishes at Andiamo.

Relaxing Amenities
Unwind in the spacious outdoor pool and whirlpool, or enjoy a drink at Landings Bar. The modern rooms with cable TV and the on-site fitness center cater to all your needs.

Book your stay at Hilton Los Angeles Airport for a memorable and comfortable experience.

categories.name: Cleanliness
categories.description: Overall reviewers frequently noted clean and well-maintained rooms and public areas; isolated severe cleanliness failures were reported in one review but are not the norm.

categories.name: Service
categories.description: Staff repeatedly described as helpful, friendly and professional with reliable shuttle staff; a few reports cite a combative manager and shuttle delays which temper the score.

categories.name: Location
categories.description: Strong positive sentiment for airport proximity and convenience (easy shuttle access, close to car rental companies); location is a clear strength.

categories.name: Room Quality
categories.description: Mixed feedback: many praise large, comfortable and quiet rooms, but several complaints about small 4-star rooms, cramped bathrooms, weak shower flow, and some reports of damaged linens/fixtures.

categories.name: Amenities
categories.description: Amenities like free airport shuttle and 24hr fitness center are praised; however shuttle wait times, occasional lack of small in-room items (water kettle) and pricey on-site outlets reduce the score.

categories.name: Value for Money
categories.description: Frequent comments that the hotel is pricey (extra taxes, expensive breakfast, parking fees) and that cost-benefit is not ideal for a 4-star property.

categories.name: Food and Beverage
categories.description: Breakfast is described as good/tasty by several guests, but multiple mentions of high prices for breakfast, bar and lobby store lower the sentiment.

categories.name: Overall Experience
categories.description: Most guests describe a calm, convenient and generally positive stay with willingness to return; isolated severe negative incidents affect some experiences but do not dominate overall sentiment.

cons: Inconsistent room quality (small bathrooms, occasional broken fixtures or poor linen)
No in-room water bottle or kettle mentioned
Some guests expected better value for a 4-star property

reviews.name: Rebecca Elphick
reviews.headline: Comfy beds, great staff, great restaurant!
reviews.pros:
Reception staff were amazing! He upgraded for me so my son could see the aeroplanes at the airport! (Thank you so much!) 
Beds were comfy, and decent size rooms! 
We had dinner at the Landings Bar & Grill. What a fabulous meal it was! Highly recommend!
